trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the outbound call.
steps.expected_behavior: Initiate the call by identifying the patient ID and stating the context of pre-authorisation.
steps.text: Hello, ID PT-2009 க்கான patient கிட்ட பேசுறேனா? உங்க pre-authorisation request பத்தி பேச hospital லிருந்து call பண்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must establish contact regarding the specific patient ID provided in the scenario context.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge identity and ask for the status.
steps.clean_text: ஆமா, நான் தான் பேசுறேன். Preauth status என்ன ஆச்சு?
steps.model_visible_text: ஆமா, நான் தான் பேசுறேன். Preauth status என்ன ஆச்சு?

steps.purpose: Request verification factors before disclosing sensitive information.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for non-sensitive knowledge factors to verify the caller's identity.
steps.text: Details share பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி, KYC verification காக உங்க date of birth மற்றும் registered pincode சொல்லுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules dictate that identity must be verified before disclosing medical or financial details.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factors.
steps.clean_text: என்னோட date of birth வந்து 12th May 1985. என்னோட Pincode நம்பர் 600017.
steps.model_visible_text: என்னோட date of birth வந்து 12th May 1985. என்னோட Pincode நம்பர் 600017.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the verify_customer_identity tool with the factors offered.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided their date of birth and pincode, which must be validated.

steps.purpose: Return the verification outcome.
Ask for policy details to proceed with the preauth update.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask the user to confirm their policy number and procedure for the record.
steps.text: Thank you. KYC verification முடிஞ்சது. உங்க pre-authorisation request பத்தி பேச தான் call பண்ணேன். Record காக உங்க policy number மற்றும் எந்த procedure கு apply பண்ணீங்க னு சொல்ல முடியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent asks for the policy number and procedure to look up the details.

steps.purpose: Provide policy number, procedure, and mention the partial approval message.
steps.clean_text: என் policy number POL-55509. நான் Knee Replacement காக private room கேட்டு apply பண்ணி இருந்தேன். எனக்கு partial approval னு ஒரு message வந்துச்சு. ஏன் அப்படி?
steps.model_visible_text: என் policy number POL-55509. நான் Knee Replacement காக private room கேட்டு apply பண்ணி இருந்தேன். எனக்கு partial approval னு ஒரு message வந்துச்சு. ஏன் அப்படி?

steps.purpose: Retrieve policy coverage details to explain the partial approval.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_policy_coverage using the policy number provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided their policy number and asked why it was partially approved. The agent needs to check the actual remaining balance.

steps.purpose: Return the policy coverage details including the depleted balance.
Explain that the remaining balance is lower than the total sum insured.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact sum insured and remaining balance from the tool result.
steps.text: நான் உங்க StarHealth policy check பண்ணிட்டேன். Total sum insured 3 lakhs தான், ஆனா உங்க current balance 1,20,000 தான் இருக்கு. அதனால தான் partial approval ஆகிருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response in the tool output to explain why the approval is partial despite a 3 lakh sum insured.

steps.purpose: Ask for the hospital package estimate for the private room to understand the shortfall.
steps.clean_text: Balance 1.2 lakhs இருக்கா? சரி, அப்போ நான் கேட்ட private room கான hospital package estimate எவ்ளோ போட்ருக்காங்க? ஏன் அது பத்தல?
steps.model_visible_text: Balance 1.2 lakhs இருக்கா? சரி, அப்போ நான் கேட்ட private room கான hospital package estimate எவ்ளோ போட்ருக்காங்க? ஏன் அது பத்தல?

steps.purpose: Retrieve the package estimate for the procedure to explain the cost difference.
steps.expected_behavior: Select estimate_procedure_cost over lookup_policy_coverage to answer the question about the hospital package.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked for the hospital estimate for the private room. The agent must choose the correct tool to fetch the package cost.

steps.purpose: Return the package estimate for a private room.
Explain the shortfall using the package estimate and the balance.
steps.expected_behavior: State the package estimate and compare it to the balance without inventing arithmetic.
steps.text: நீங்க private room கேட்டு இருந்தீங்க, அதோட package estimate 1,50,000. உங்க balance 1,20,000 இருக்கறதால, insurer அந்த amount தான் cover பண்ணுவாங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Adhering to BR_PA_03 (Balance truth) by explaining the cost versus the balance.

steps.purpose: Reject the private room and ask for the cost of a general ward.
steps.clean_text: அது ரொம்ப அதிகம். Private room வேணாம். general ward எடுத்தா எவ்ளோ ஆகும்?
steps.model_visible_text: அது ரொம்ப அதிகம். Private room வேணாம். general board எடுத்தா எவ்ளோ ஆகும்?

steps.purpose: Check the estimate for a general ward.
steps.expected_behavior: Call estimate_procedure_cost with room_category set to general, overcoming the STT error.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer wants to know the cost for a general ward to see if it fits within their remaining balance.

steps.purpose: Return the package estimate for a general ward.
Inform the customer of the general ward cost and that it fits their balance.
steps.expected_behavior: State the general ward estimate and confirm it is within the 1,20,000 balance.
steps.text: General ward எடுத்தா, package estimate 1,00,000 ஆகும். இது உங்க balance குள்ள fully cover ஆகிடும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the new cost so the customer can make a decision on how to proceed.

steps.purpose: Instruct the agent to submit a new preauth for the general ward.
steps.clean_text: Super. அப்போ general ward கே preauth submit பண்ணிடுங்க. நான் extra pay பண்ண முடியாது.
steps.model_visible_text: Super. அப்போ general ward கே preauth submit பண்ணிடுங்க. நான் extra pay பண்ண முடியாது.

steps.purpose: Submit a new preauth request for the general ward amount.
steps.expected_behavior: Submit the preauth request with the revised estimated amount of 100000.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer agreed to the general ward, so a new pre-authorisation request must be submitted for the lower package cost.

steps.purpose: Return the outcome of the new preauth submission.
Confirm submission and state the decision window without guaranteeing approval.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the preauth ID and decision hours, explicitly avoiding any promise of approval.
steps.text: நான் general ward க்கு புதுசா ஒரு request submit பண்ணிருக்கேன். உங்க preauth ID PR-8834. StarHealth கிட்ட இருந்து முடிவு வர 4 hours ஆகும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfills the terminal success condition and adheres to BR_PA_01 by not promising approval.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.

In e12, have the user explicitly mention they requested a 'private' room to justify the room_category argument in e13.

verifications.summary: The conversation demonstrates good tool selection and effectively handles the sceptical persona. However, the agent hallucinates several key identifiers and statuses (procedure, policy number, room category, partial approval) before they are established in the context, violating the strict grounding requirements. A plan repair is required to have the user introduce these details to justify the agent's subsequent tool calls and claims.

variant_findings.reason: The customer asks for the hospital package estimate for a private room. The agent correctly selects the 'estimate_procedure_cost' tool over 'lookup_policy_coverage' to retrieve the specific package cost, fulfilling the requirement of choosing the appropriate tool among multiple candidates based on the stated goal.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently uses the exact figures returned by the tools (sum insured, balance, package estimates, preauth ID, and decision hours) without inventing any arithmetic or making unsupported forward guarantees about the approval.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verifications.summary: The conversation successfully realizes all target variants and adheres strictly to the business rules and persona instructions. The agent correctly selects tools based on the user's queries, grounds all numerical values and statuses in the tool outputs, and manages the STT error seamlessly. The 'sceptical_disputer' persona is well-executed, challenging the figures before accepting the evidenced explanation. The script mode and language quality are excellent.
